name: Callweave Runtime
summary: Executes governed capabilities deterministically and records traces.
description: Executes the standalone capability graph across supported targets while preserving deterministic local-first behavior. Cares that pure capabilities remain portable, workflow-agnostic, and explicit about blocked host integrations such as microphone, storage, scheduling, and model connectors.

distinguished_from.how: Runs the execution surface and orchestration semantics, while the field operator is concerned with obtaining and staging recordings.
Executes capabilities under an existing configuration but does not own installation policy or administrative setup changes.
